note: Configuration field carries attacker-controlled network-partition interface names into the implementation.
The code duplicates and iterates the interface_names string for each configured network partition.

If interface_names was never initialized, ddsrt_strdup reads an indeterminate pointer instead of a valid string; the safety obligation is that np->interface_names must be initialized before duplication.
The duplicated buffer is freed after tokenization; when copy is derived from an invalid/uninitialized source, this cleanup path can become an invalid free.
